about.title: About me
about.description1: I am passionate about fitness and I believe every person deserves to feel great in their own skin. With years of experience in personal training, yoga and nutrition, I offer you a complete program adapted to your needs.
about.description2: My approach is holistic — I don't just focus on the physical aspect, but also on your mental and emotional wellbeing. Every session is designed to bring you joy and energy.
about.description3: Regardless of your fitness level or goals, I'm here to guide you step by step toward the best version of yourself.
